Depends on your progress in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest

The {wiki:Brotherhood Outfits|Brotherhood Outfits} (Brotherhood of Bones) are obtained by using three brotherhood documents that you earn in the missions of the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest|Dreamer's Challenge Quest}, in the Plains of Havoc. Each document unlocks a part of the outfit; the quest also gives the achievement **Skull and Bones**.
Dreamer's Challenge Quest entrance (Plains of Havoc)
Missions 1 to 4 of the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest|Dreamer's Challenge Quest} for the outfit; mission 5 for addon 1; mission 6 for addon 2.
The documents are obtained by completing missions 1 to 7 of the Dreamer's Challenge Quest (or bought from someone who has already completed them).

In the Plains of Havoc and the Dreamer's Challenge Quest you will face countless demonic creatures: prepare well.

Complete **missions 1 to 4** of the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest|Dreamer's Challenge Quest}. The entrance is in the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, southwest of Venore: from the Plains of Havoc temple walk **east** to the ruined building, use the {item:Shovel} on the hole to the **northeast** and go down; further on you clear the way with a {item:Pick}.
You will face countless demonic creatures.

To leave the {wiki:Dream Realm}, step into the teleport near {npc:A Ghostly Guardian}. After you join the Brotherhood you can use the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower} teleports (Carlin, Thais and Dream Realm; more cities with the next ranks) so you do not have to cross the Plains of Havoc again: you always need an {item:Orichalcum Pearl}. The full route is in the Dreamer's Challenge Quest guide.
